description: Synthetic versioned benchmark cases for Phase 2. Fixtures are reference expectations, not executable rules or claims that an inference engine already exists.

fixtures.title: Two mentions explicitly share one referent

task.goal: Determine whether m1 and m2 identify the same referent.

fixtures.title: Identical labels do not establish identity

task.goal: Determine whether matching labels alone license coreference.

fixtures.title: A Referent ID cannot be used as a Source reference

task.goal: Validate evidence.source_ref using typed-reference spaces.

fixtures.title: NOT scopes over the existential quantifier

task.goal: Preserve NOT(EXISTS x HUMAN(x)) without changing quantifier scope.

fixtures.title: EXISTS NOT is not NOT EXISTS

task.goal: Distinguish EXISTS y NOT HUMAN(y) from NOT EXISTS y HUMAN(y).

fixtures.title: Modus ponens is licensed by the explicit reference rule

task.goal: Apply the explicit benchmark modus-ponens rule to derive GROUND_WET in world.

rules.description: From asserted A and asserted A implies B, derive B in the same context.

fixtures.title: An implication does not license its converse

task.goal: Given A and A implies B, determine whether B implies A follows.

rules.description: From asserted A and asserted A implies B, derive B in the same context.

fixtures.title: Agent and patient role bindings remain ordered

task.goal: Determine whether object-b is also the AGENT.

fixtures.title: STATE and PROCESS kinds are not coerced

task.goal: Use a rule requiring PROCESS on an expression grounded as STATE.

fixtures.title: Possibility does not assert actuality

task.goal: Determine whether POSSIBLE(RAIN) licenses actual-world RAIN.

fixtures.title: An attributed belief is not the narrator's assertion

task.goal: Determine whether the attributed belief is an unqualified actual-world source assertion.

fixtures.title: BEFORE remains directed

task.goal: Return the represented temporal order without reversing its operands.

fixtures.title: Fictional context does not transfer into WORLD

task.goal: Determine whether DRAGON_EXISTS is asserted in world.

fixtures.title: Exact quote alignment does not establish semantic support

task.goal: Assess alignment and support as independent axes.

fixtures.title: Unicode code-point spans remain correct after emoji

task.goal: Validate the exact source span for Alex using code-point offsets.

fixtures.title: An aligned but irrelevant quote is not support

task.goal: Assess exact alignment separately from relevance/support.

fixtures.title: Conjunction elimination requires its declared rule

task.goal: Apply the benchmark's explicit left-conjunction-elimination rule.

fixtures.title: CAUSE labels do not imply transitivity

task.goal: Determine whether CAUSE(a,c) follows without a transitivity rule.

fixtures.title: Missing records in an open world do not imply negation

task.goal: Determine whether absent HAS_LICENSE(person-b) means NOT HAS_LICENSE(person-b).

fixtures.title: Complete closed-domain policy permits declared negation by absence

task.goal: Evaluate HAS_LICENSE(person-b) under the explicitly complete closed-domain rule.
assumptions: Only this named domain is closed and complete.

fixtures.title: An incomplete closed domain does not license absence-as-negation

task.goal: Evaluate missing HAS_LICENSE(person-b) against a domain marked incomplete.

fixtures.title: Two quotations from one source are not independent corroboration

task.goal: Determine whether the two evidence records establish independent corroboration.

fixtures.title: Duplicate definition labels remain ambiguous without exact identity

task.goal: Resolve the label open without a unique definition ID/version.

fixtures.title: An unresolved antecedent does not create a Referent

task.goal: Resolve the agent only if an explicit antecedent identity link exists.

fixtures.title: Conflicting assertions remain visible without arbitrary winner selection

task.goal: Report conflict and preserve both assertions without choosing by recency or count.

fixtures.title: OPAQUE expressions are not inference-eligible

task.goal: Determine whether an opaque expression can be a premise for an enabled rule.

fixtures.title: A conditional alone does not supply its antecedent

task.goal: Use modus ponens only if both antecedent and conditional premises are asserted.

rules.description: From asserted A and asserted A implies B, derive B in the same context.

fixtures.title: A conclusion has complete rule and input provenance

task.goal: Derive B and retain the exact rule version plus ordered premise references.

rules.description: From asserted A and asserted A implies B, derive B in the same context.

fixtures.title: Repeated runs retain deterministic output and order

task.goal: Run the identical task twice and compare normalized semantic output.
task.determinism_policy: Compare structured semantic output and preserve meaningful array order; exclude runtime IDs and timing fields only.

fixtures.title: Interruption is incomplete, explicit, and loss-preserving

task.goal: Interrupt after a small operation budget and preserve every input expression without truncation.
task.resource_policy: Budget controls execution only; it is not a semantic item or operand cap.

fixtures.title: Lexical similarity does not establish concept identity

task.goal: Determine whether matching labels or similarity alone prove identity/equivalence.

fixtures.title: Conflicting evidence assessments do not become VERIFIED

task.goal: Represent support and dispute together without automatic epistemic promotion.

fixtures.title: A model proposal is not an executable rule

task.goal: Do not emit C solely because a model proposed it when no enabled matching rule exists.

fixtures.title: Past tense does not silently become present tense

task.goal: Determine whether a past-tense assertion establishes the proposition in the present interval.

fixtures.title: UNKNOWN, UNRESOLVED, and AMBIGUOUS remain distinct

task.goal: Preserve all distinct statuses without normalizing them to one generic unresolved state.
